subject.title: [Bug] sanitizeForPromptLiteral destructively strips tabs and newlines

question: Should horizontal tabs be permitted globally by sanitizeForPromptLiteral, or preserved only inside explicitly framed untrusted data blocks?
rationale: Current main intentionally strips tabs across workspace paths, identifiers, metadata, approval paths, and framed blocks, while the demonstrated fidelity problem is specific to structured framed data; changing that shared boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Preserve only in framed blocks
options.body: Keep the strict literal sanitizer and introduce a narrowly scoped layout-preserving path for tagged data blocks with hostile-input regression coverage.

options.title: Preserve tabs globally
options.body: Change the shared sanitizer contract only after auditing every caller and proving prompt structure remains protected.

options.title: Keep strict stripping
options.body: Retain current behavior and document that untrusted structured text is intentionally normalized for prompt integrity.

recommendation.title: Preserve only in framed blocks
recommendation.body: Keep the strict literal sanitizer and introduce a narrowly scoped layout-preserving path for tagged data blocks with hostile-input regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The strict shared sanitizer and its explicit stripping tests originate in their security-hardening work.
